```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Loads the data and the high-level functions; the helpers stay out of
# the global environment.
source("R/load_project.R")
load_project()
```

To start the app, open this file in RStudio and run the chunk below (the
green arrow at its top right). Knitting the file only shows the code, because
an app cannot run inside a static HTML page.

```{r app, eval = FALSE}
shiny::runApp(happiness_app(
  combined_data, available_predictors,
  predictor_groups = group_predictors(available_predictors),
  predictor_notes = predictor_notes,
  variable_info = variable_info
))
```

## Assumption checks

The regression assumptions are checked for every predictor in the simple
model happiness ~ predictor (README, Methods). The counts:

```{r assumption-checks}
assumption_checks <- check_assumptions()
knitr::kable(assumption_checks$summary)
```

Nearby countries are more alike than the model predicts (Moran's I of the
residuals), less so with continent as control:

```{r spatial}
knitr::kable(assumption_checks$spatial, digits = 3)
```

The effect with continent as control, with standard errors clustered by
continent (a robustness check; with only 6 clusters, interpret it with
caution):

```{r clustered}
knitr::kable(assumption_checks$clustered, digits = 3)
```
